entries.title: According to Paragraph 1, the author's posts on Twitter ___.
entries.text: According to Paragraph 1, the author's posts on Twitter ___. [A] illustrated the development of Victorian photography 展现了维多利亚时代摄影的发展 [B] highlighted social media's role in Victorian studies 凸显了社交媒体在维多利亚研究中的作用 [C] re-evaluated the Victorians' notion of public image 重新评价了维多利亚时代人对公众形象的观念 [D] changed people's impression of the Victorians 答案 D According to Paragraph 1, the author's posts on Twitter ___.根据第1段，作者在Twitter上的帖子___。 [A] illustrated the development of Victorian photography展现了维多利亚时代摄影的发展 [B] highlighted social media's role in Victorian studies凸显了社交媒体在维多利亚研究中的作用 [C] re-evaluated the Victorians' notion of public image重新评价了维多利亚时代人对公众形象的观念 [D] changed people's impression of the Victorians 💡 考场思路首段：人们惊讶地发现维多利亚人也会笑，他们"突然显得更像人"——即改变了对维多利亚人的刻板印象。

entries.title: What does the author say about the Victorian portraits he has collected?
entries.text: What does the author say about the Victorian portraits he has collected? [A] They are rare among photographs of that age. [B] They show effects of different exposure times. 它们展示了不同时长曝光的效果。 [C] They mirror 19th-century social conventions. 它们折射出19世纪的社会习俗。 [D] They are in popular use among historians. 它们在历史学家中普遍使用。 答案 A What does the author say about the Victorian portraits he has collected?作者对他收藏的维多利亚时代肖像有什么看法？ [A] They are rare among photographs of that age. [B] They show effects of different exposure times.它们展示了不同时长曝光的效果。 [C] They mirror 19th-century social conventions.它们折射出19世纪的社会习俗。 [D] They are in popular use among historians.它们在历史学家中普遍使用。 💡 考场思路第二段：微笑的维多利亚照片只占"tiny percentage"——即在那个年代的照片中很罕见。

entries.title: What might have kept the Victorians from smiling for pictures in the 1890s?
entries.text: What might have kept the Victorians from smiling for pictures in the 1890s? [A] Their inherent social sensitiveness. 它们固有的社会敏感性。 [B] Their tension before the camera. 他们在镜头前的紧张。 [C] Their unhealthy dental condition. [D] Their distrust of new inventions. 他们对新发明的不信任。 答案 C What might have kept the Victorians from smiling for pictures in the 1890s?是什么让维多利亚时代的人在19世纪90年代对图片保持微笑？ [A] Their inherent social sensitiveness.它们固有的社会敏感性。 [B] Their tension before the camera.他们在镜头前的紧张。 [C] Their unhealthy dental condition. [D] Their distrust of new inventions.他们对新发明的不信任。 💡 考场思路第五、六段：曝光已不是问题后，原因转向牙齿——口腔卫生差、牙齿发黑有缝，露齿笑不体面。

entries.title: Mark Twain is quoted to show that the disapproval of smiles in pictures was ___.
entries.text: Mark Twain is quoted to show that the disapproval of smiles in pictures was ___. [A] a thought-provoking idea 一个发人深省的观点 [B] a misguided attitude 一种被误导的态度 [C] a controversial view 一个有争议的观点 [D] a deep-rooted belief 答案 D Mark Twain is quoted to show that the disapproval of smiles in pictures was ___.引用马克·吐温的话来表明，图片中对微笑的不赞成是___。 [A] a thought-provoking idea一个发人深省的观点 [B] a misguided attitude一种被误导的态度 [C] a controversial view一个有争议的观点 [D] a deep-rooted belief 💡 考场思路连爱开怀大笑的马克·吐温都认为照片上的笑糟透了——说明对照片微笑的反感是根深蒂固的观念。

entries.title: Which of the following questions does the text answer?
entries.text: Which of the following questions does the text answer? [A] Why did most Victorians look stern in photographs? [B] When did the Victorians start to view photography differently? 维多利亚时代的人是何时开始以不同眼光看待摄影的？ [C] What made photography develop slowly in the Victorian period? 是什么让摄影在维多利亚时期发展缓慢？ [D] How did smiling in photographs become a post-Victorian norm? 照片中的微笑是如何成为后维多利亚时代规范的？ 答案 A Which of the following questions does the text answer?文本回答了以下哪些问题？ [A] Why did most Victorians look stern in photographs? [B] When did the Victorians start to view photography differently?维多利亚时代的人是何时开始以不同眼光看待摄影的？ [C] What made photography develop slowly in the Victorian period?是什么让摄影在维多利亚时期发展缓慢？ [D] How did smiling in photographs become a post-Victorian norm?照片中的微笑是如何成为后维多利亚时代规范的？ 💡 考场思路第二段末直接发问"How do we explain this trend?"（为什么维多利亚人拍照不笑），全文即回答此问。 核心词汇 preoccupied adj. 痴迷的 prudery n. 拘谨 concede v. 承认 daguerreotype n. 达盖尔银版法 dignity n. 体面/尊严 damning adj. 糟透的/定罪的

entries.title: There has long been concern that broadband providers would ___.
entries.text: There has long been concern that broadband providers would ___. [A] bring web-based firms under control 将网络公司置于管控之下 [B] slow down the traffic on their network 减缓其网络上的流量 [C] show partiality in treating clients [D] intensify competition with their rivals 加剧与对手的竞争 答案 C There has long been concern that broadband providers would ___.长期以来，人们一直担心宽带提供商会___。 [A] bring web-based firms under control将网络公司置于管控之下 [B] slow down the traffic on their network减缓其网络上的流量 [C] show partiality in treating clients [D] intensify competition with their rivals加剧与对手的竞争 💡 考场思路首段：担心宽带商有动机"favor affiliated websites over their rivals"——偏袒一部分客户。

entries.title: Faced with the demand for net neutrality rules, the FCC ___.
entries.text: Faced with the demand for net neutrality rules, the FCC ___. [A] sticks to an out-of-date order 固守一种过时的秩序 [B] takes an anti-regulatory stance [C] has issued a special resolution 已发布一项特别决议 [D] has allowed the states to intervene 已允许各州介入 答案 B Faced with the demand for net neutrality rules, the FCC ___.面对网络中立规则的需求， FCC ___。 [A] sticks to an out-of-date order固守一种过时的秩序 [B] takes an anti-regulatory stance [C] has issued a special resolution已发布一项特别决议 [D] has allowed the states to intervene已允许各州介入 💡 考场思路第二段：FCC 2017年废除严格的网络中立规则、否定自己的监管权——持反监管立场。

entries.title: What can be learned about AT&T from Paragraph 3?
entries.text: What can be learned about AT&T from Paragraph 3? [A] It protects against unfair competition. 它防范不公平竞争。 [B] It engages in anti-competitive practices. [C] It is under the FCC's investigation. 它正受到FCC的调查。 [D] It is in pursuit of quality service. 它追求高质量服务。 答案 B What can be learned about AT&T from Paragraph 3?关于AT&T ，可以从第3段中学到什么？ [A] It protects against unfair competition.它防范不公平竞争。 [B] It engages in anti-competitive practices. [C] It is under the FCC's investigation.它正受到FCC的调查。 [D] It is in pursuit of quality service.它追求高质量服务。 💡 考场思路第三段：AT&T偏袒自家流媒体、牺牲奈飞——这正是反竞争行为。

entries.title: Judge Patricia Millett argues that the appeals court's decision ___.
entries.text: Judge Patricia Millett argues that the appeals court's decision ___. [A] focuses on trivialities 纠结于细枝末节 [B] conveys an ambiguous message 传递出模棱两可的信息 [C] is at odds with its earlier rulings 与其早先的裁决相抵触 [D] is out of touch with reality 答案 D Judge Patricia Millett argues that the appeals court's decision ___.Patricia Millett法官辩称，上诉法院的裁决___。 [A] focuses on trivialities纠结于细枝末节 [B] conveys an ambiguous message传递出模棱两可的信息 [C] is at odds with its earlier rulings与其早先的裁决相抵触 [D] is out of touch with reality 💡 考场思路第四段：Millett说裁决"unhinged from the realities of modern broadband service"——脱离现实。

entries.title: What does the author argue in the last paragraph?
entries.text: What does the author argue in the last paragraph? [A] Congress needs to take action to ensure net neutrality. [B] The FCC should be put under strict supervision. FCC应受到严格监管。 [C] Rules need to be set to diversify online services. 需制定规则使在线服务多样化。 [D] Broadband providers' rights should be protected. 宽带提供商的权利应受保护。 答案 A What does the author argue in the last paragraph?作者在最后一段中提出了什么观点？ [A] Congress needs to take action to ensure net neutrality. [B] The FCC should be put under strict supervision.FCC应受到严格监管。 [C] Rules need to be set to diversify online services.需制定规则使在线服务多样化。 [D] Broadband providers' rights should be protected.宽带提供商的权利应受保护。 💡 考场思路末段首句：endless battles cry out for Congress to act——国会需采取行动。 核心词汇 net neutrality 网络中立 affiliated adj. 关联的 deregulate v. 放松监管 unanimously adv. 一致地 uphold v. 维持 meddle in 干预

entries.title: Those societies came out of the war with levels of enrollment that had been roug
entries.text: Those societies came out of the war with levels of enrollment that had been roughly constant at 3-5% of the relevant age groups during the decades before the war. Those societies came out of the war with levels of enrollment that had been roughly constant at 3-5% of the relevant age groups during the decades before the war. 这些经历了二战的国家，战前数十年适龄人口的高校入学率一直维持在3%至5%左右。 采分点① come out of the war 走出战争；② enrollment 入学率；③ roughly constant 大致稳定；④ relevant age groups 相关年龄组。

entries.title: And the demand that rose in those societies for entry to higher education extend
entries.text: And the demand that rose in those societies for entry to higher education extended to groups and social classes that had not thought of attending a university before the war. And the demand that rose in those societies for entry to higher education extended to groups and social classes that had not thought of attending a university before the war. 在这些国家里，接受高等教育的需求日益高涨，已扩展到战前从未想过接受大学教育的各个团体以及社会阶层。 采分点① demand that rose 高涨的需求；② entry to higher education 进入高等教育；③ extended to 扩展到；④ 两个定语从句的处理。

entries.title: In many countries of Western Europe, the numbers of students in higher education
entries.text: In many countries of Western Europe, the numbers of students in higher education doubled within five-year periods during the 1960s and doubled again in seven, eight, or 10 years by the middle of the 1970s. In many countries of Western Europe, the numbers of students in higher education doubled within five-year periods during the 1960s and doubled again in seven, eight, or 10 years by the middle of the 1970s. 在西欧很多国家，20世纪60年代接受高等教育的学生数量在五年内增加了一倍。在20世纪70年代中期，又在七年、八年或十年内再次增倍。 采分点① double 翻番；② within five-year periods 五年之内；③ by the middle of the 1970s 到70年代中期。

entries.title: and when the new staff are predominantly young men and women fresh from postgrad
entries.text: and when the new staff are predominantly young men and women fresh from postgraduate study, they largely define the norms of academic life in that faculty. and when the new staff are predominantly young men and women fresh from postgraduate study, they largely define the norms of academic life in that faculty. 并且当新员工主要是刚毕业的研究生时，他们就在很大程度上确定了该院系学术生活的规范。 采分点① predominantly 主要地；② fresh from postgraduate study 刚从研究生毕业；③ define the norms 确立规范；④ faculty 院系。

entries.title: High growth rates increased the chances for academic innovation; they also weake
entries.text: High growth rates increased the chances for academic innovation; they also weakened the forms and processes by which teachers and students are admitted into a community of scholars during periods of stability or slow growth. High growth rates increased the chances for academic innovation; they also weakened the forms and processes by which teachers and students are admitted into a community of scholars during periods of stability or slow growth. 高增长率增加了学术创新的机会，但它们也削弱了教师和学生在稳定期或缓慢增长期间被纳入学术团队的形式和过程。 采分点① academic innovation 学术创新；② weaken 削弱；③ be admitted into 被纳入；④ a community of scholars 学术共同体。

In your essay, you should 1) describe the drawing briefly, 2) explain its intended meaning, and 3) give your comments. You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. Picture: The cartoon shows a child in traditional Chinese opera costume saying to his father, "Dad, many classmates think learning opera is no fun." The father replies, "Don't you like it yourself? That's enough." 【译文】根据下面的图画写一篇160–200词的短文。文中应： 1）简要描述图画；2）说明其寓意；3）给出你的评论。 请在答题卡2上工整书写。 漫画中一个扮成戏曲行当的孩子对爸爸说：“爸爸，好多同学觉得学唱戏不好玩。”父亲回答：“你自己不是喜欢吗？那就足够了。” 图画解读 扮成戏曲行当的孩子对爸爸说："爸爸，好多同学觉得学唱戏不好玩。"父亲回答："你自己不是喜欢吗？那就足够了。"漫画寓意：面对他人不理解，坚持自己真正热爱的事物，不必随波逐流。 审题框架 三段式：①描述父子对话；②点明寓意——听从内心热爱，而非盲从他人评价；③评论：坚守热爱方能有所成就。160-200词。 参考范文 The cartoon depicts a touching dialogue between a father and his son in traditional Chinese opera costume. The child worries that many classmates find learning opera boring, to which the father gently replies, "But don't you love it yourself? That is enough." The message is both simple and profound: when we are genuinely passionate about something, the judgment of others should not dictate our choices.
